Key verbatim findings: `getProfileFromEvent` picks `styleProfile = team || event.parent?.team || nonTeamProfile` (`packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:591`) — a team event falls back to the parent org, a personal event stops at the user; and its `userSelect` organization block (`:41-47`) never selects `brandColor`/`darkBrandColor`/`theme`. The personal profile page sets `theme: user.theme, brandColor: user.brandColor ?? DEFAULT…` (`apps/web/server/lib/[user]/getServerSideProps.ts:133-145`), and `UserRepository.teamSelect` (`packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:71-80`), `ProfileRepository.organizationSelect` (`packages/features/profile/repositories/ProfileRepository.ts:44-53`) and `OrganizationWithRequestedSlug` (`packages/types/UserProfile.d.ts:3-5`) all omit those columns.

{
  "contract": "Every public booking surface must resolve its visual identity — brandColor, darkBrandColor and the light/dark theme preference — from the same entity hierarchy: the organisation that owns the entity being booked takes precedence over (or at minimum supplies the fallback for) the individual member's own appearance settings, exactly as it already does for a team's events via the team's parent organisation. Any query that feeds a public page must therefore select the organisation's branding columns, any type that carries an organisation onto a user profile must declare them, and any page or hook that applies theme/brand must take them from that resolved profile rather than from the member record alone.",

    "summary": "The branding hierarchy is implemented only on the team path. packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:585-614 computes `styleProfile = team || event.parent?.team || nonTeamProfile`, so a team event inherits the parent organisation's brandColor/darkBrandColor/theme (lines 606-608), while a personal event type falls through to `nonTeamProfile` — the user — and the user's organisation is never consulted. The organisation branding is not even fetched on that path: the user select at packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:31-48 pulls `organization: { id, name, slug, bannerUrl }` with no brand or theme columns. The same omission repeats upstream: packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:71-80 (`teamSelect`, used by `findUsersByUsername` at :169-179 for the personal pages) and packages/features/profile/repositories/ProfileRepository.ts:44-53 (`organizationSelect`) both stop at logoUrl/bannerUrl/hideBranding, and the shared type packages/types/UserProfile.d.ts:3-5 declares the attached organisation as Pick<Team, \"name\"|\"id\"|\"slug\"|\"calVideoLogo\"|\"bannerUrl\"> only. Consequently apps/web/server/lib/[user]/getServerSideProps.ts:133-145 builds the personal-link profile as `theme: user.theme, brandColor: user.brandColor ?? DEFAULT_LIGHT_BRAND_COLOR, darkBrandColor: user.darkBrandColor ?? DEFAULT_DARK_BRAND_COLOR`, and apps/web/modules/users/views/users-public-view.tsx:29 applies only `useTheme(profile.theme)` with no brand colours at all.
